svg.title: Deterministic native Chaos suite - required evidence and verdicts
svg.desc: Independent verdicts for baseline, exact-instance process crash, zone-selected process crash, PostgreSQL failover, combined overlapping effects and genuine infrastructure-zone loss. Every issued write must be reconciled. Private SCM and actual six-worker three-zone participation passed. An external database stop blocks the full baseline and native fault suite.
svg.text: Deterministic native Chaos suite - evidence contract
Private SCM and six-worker placement verified; all six suite verdicts BLOCKED after an external database stop.
Mandatory readiness gate before every fault
Actual six Linux workers / three physical zones / all-instance health and business traffic / private app and SCM
Owned native targets; healthy private PostgreSQL HA; failover cooldown >= 20 min; one bounded, attributable load.
BASE-001
5 min warmup + 10 min baseline; success >= 99.9%; p95 <= 1 s.
Capture health/traffic identity, every issued operation, canary and acknowledged-write reconciliation.
HA-APP-001
Native Kill process; exact nonempty InstanceIds selection; prove actual PID/start-time change.
Observe >= 5 min after effect; success >= 99%; p95 <= 2 s; complete-unavailability gap <= 5 s.
HA-APP-ZONE-001
Native Kill process with verified Zones selection and actual physical/logical mapping.
Evidence covers selected-zone instance effects and unaffected zones; apply app-only thresholds.
HA-DB-001
Native ForcedFailover=1; independently observe DB disruption and primary/standby role swap.
Observe >= 10 min; recovery <= 180 s to start of qualifying 60 s stable window.
HA-COMBINED-001
Independently evidenced DB-disruption and application-effect overlap.
Concurrent submissions alone provide no overlap evidence; apply DB/combined recovery requirements.
For each phase: availability + recovery + durability remain separate verdicts
Errors / drops / latency / recovery; resolve every issued write; zero lost acknowledgements, duplicates or checksum mismatches.
Preserve raw clocks, instance/PID evidence, Action state, DB state and complete post-recovery observations.
HA-AZ-001: BLOCKED without qualifying correlated infrastructure-zone outage evidence
Discrete process crashes establish process-fault behavior. A sustained real-zone outage needs its own injection and observation.
Modern Workspaces / Scenarios / native Actions. Linux stays selected. Preserve resources; the operator manually deletes the groups.
